entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Mike. How can I help you today?
Hi, Mike. I'd like to start a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought a few weeks ago.
Okay, you want to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. No problem at all. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0125. Is there going to be any issue? I've had it for about twenty days now.
Let me see... VF886-0125. Got it. And no, there's no issue at all. Our policy allows returns for up to 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Oh, 10 days? That's great! I wasn't sure what the policy was.
Yep, it's a straightforward process. I can email you a prepaid return label right now. Just print it out, stick it on the box, and drop it at any post office. Does the email on file work for you?
Yes, that's perfect. Wow, that was easy. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. The email with the return label is on its way. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks again, Mike.
Happy to help. Thanks for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
